title: BookingIssueResolved
description: An operator resolved a reported problem; the haul is no longer under review.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

shipper_user_id.description: The person who posted the load.

resolution.title: IssueResolution
resolution.description: `continue`: the haul goes on as it was. `cancel`: cancelled without penalty to either side (a `booking.cancelled` follows). `reprice`: the price was recalculated. `waiting_fee`: a waiting charge was added.

amount.description: The new price for `reprice`, the added charge for `waiting_fee`, whole so'm; null otherwise.
